decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - Reason for approval

The scale design and location of the signage is appropriate to the building and would not harm the visual amenity of the area or traffic safety in accordance with adopted Unitary Development Plan Policies ENV-B.1.4 (Advertisements) and Policy S.4.3 (Advertisements).

Condition : 2 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (Control of Advertisements) Regulations or its successor legislation, the three existing vinyl banners suspended from the front of the building shall be removed before the signs hereby approved are first displayed, and no advertisements or signs of any sort other than those shown in the drawings hereby approved shall be displayed on the exterior of the building without the prior written approval of the local planning authority.

Condition : 3 - All advertisements displays, and any site used for the display of advertisements shall be maintained in a clean and tidy condition to the reasonable satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Installation of externally illuminated signage to public house.
